basic_info.description: First time on market in 36 years - Trophy 12-unit multifamily property located on a charming corner in the highly desirable Richmond District. This exceptional three-story building exudes timeless charm and character, offering investors a rare opportunity to acquire a well-maintained asset with significant upside potential in a high-demand rental market. The property is comprised of twelve spacious one-bedroom, one-bath units and features a garage with eight parking spaces. Units range in size from 986 to 1,150 square feet, each boasting large, separate living and dining rooms that offer the potential to expand bedroom counts and enhance rental income. All units benefit from abundant natural light, with many offering great views, including views of the ocean. The building offers coin-operated washers and dryers in the garage. Many quality finishes from its era of construction with modern updates. Fantastic opportunity for an investor to acquire an easy-to-manage multifamily property with substantial upside potential in a high-demand rental area.
